english_json: "Grant, we ask, almighty God, that the splendor of your glory may shine upon us, and that the light of your light may strengthen, through the illumination of the Holy Spirit, the hearts of those who have been reborn by your grace. Through our Lord."

"Almighty, everlasting God, who willed the paschal sacrament to be contained within the mystery of fifty days, grant that, after the scattering of the nations, the divisions of tongues may be gathered by a heavenly gift into one confession of your name. Through our Lord."
